findings.title: Tenant settings route trusts tenant_id from the path
findings.description: get_tenant_settings accepts tenant_id from the URL and queries tenant settings with it. The current_user dependency is present, but the route never checks that user.tenant_id matches the requested tenant or that the user is a member.

exploitability.assessment: Any authenticated user can read another tenant's settings by changing the path.

remediation.summary: Derive tenant_id from the authenticated principal or require an explicit membership check before returning tenant settings.
